title: slm_jev span record, v1
description: One span returned by `python -m slmjev.engine`. The first seven fields are structured_deidentification's span contract (app/R/engine_py.R); the rest are slm_jev's. Offsets are 1-based and `end` is inclusive. A published version is never edited in place.

row.description: 1-based index of the text in the request

type.description: detector type hint (e.g. nric, postal) or the judged category

identifier.description: an identifier or SHI id from labels.v1.json; for a review span judged `none`, the most likely other label; null only if the judge failed and no type hint exists

confidence.description: calibrated p(identifier); null if the judge failed

fast_path.description: the rule that accepted the span without the model

sources.description: the proposers that proposed the span
